_comment: cloud-url-health-report runtime config. Passwords NEVER live here — NOREPLY_PASSWORD + ME_PASSWORD come from env (sops-decrypted upstream).

concurrency._comment: Private concurrency intentionally low: 16 simultaneous WG probes saturate idle handshakes and cause cascading timeouts on the spokes. 4 is high-enough for the 86 private targets to finish in <30s while staying under the WG renegotiation pressure point.

timeouts._comment: Bumped 2026-05-07: WG re-handshake on idle peers can take ~3-5s before first packet, so a 3s TCP / 5s HTTP-total budget produced false negatives across the 10.0.0.6 spoke (oci-apps) when probing from desktop. New budget allows one full handshake + actual request.

targets._comment: Ports that are not HTTP servers — probe via TcpStream::connect only, skip HTTP GET.
